text: DSH Computer History 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地优先的工作历史与续接功能。它通过 DSH Host 采集应用、资源、工作区和时间元数据，在本机整理为工作片段，并在 DSH 客户端提供历史面板及 agent 工具。用户可查看时间线、搜索近期工作、查询历史证据、整理项目记忆，并将选定片段作为有限上下文续接到新会话；浏览器和编辑器 companion 可补充元数据。适合希望在不同应用间找回工作脉络的 DSH 用户。需要兼容的 DSH Host 和桌面采集权限；记录默认关闭，数据保存在本地 SQLite。

DSH Computer History adds local work history to DSH. The Host organizes app and workspace metadata into episodes, shown in a searchable timeline and agent tools. Users can review evidence and continue sessions with bounded history. Recording is off by default; data stays in local SQLite.
想从电脑上不同应用的近期活动里找回自己在做什么。
我希望把工作过程整理成时间线，之后能按项目或资源查找。
DSH 能不能根据之前的工作记录帮我接着做？
需要查询过去保存过哪些文件或做过哪些测试，并查看对应历史证据。
想在本机保留工作脉络，不把屏幕内容当成历史记录。
能否让 DSH 跨会话获取有限的项目工作上下文？
Help me pick up a project in DSH using recent work context.
I want a local timeline of the apps and resources involved in my work.
**DSH Computer History** 的功能「工作时间线」：它将应用、资源与时间等元数据整理为工作片段，供用户在客户端历史面板查看。
**DSH Computer History** 的功能「续接会话」：用户选择 Continue 后，agent 工具解析当前会话绑定并生成有界的历史交接上下文。
**DSH Computer History** 的功能「历史证据查询」：agent 可按日期、工作区、资源或事件类型检索保留的工作片段，并通过游标分页。
**DSH Computer History** 的功能「项目工作记忆」：agent 工具可读取由历史记录整理的项目记忆和关联活动线索。

dsh-computer-history README · Why this exists：A chat session knows what happened **inside the chat**. Your actual work often happens somewhere else: an editor, a terminal, Finder, a browser companion, or another desktop app.

Computer History is the missing continuity layer. It is built to answer questions such as:

- **What was I working on recently?**
- **Which project or resource was that work attached to?**
- **Where should I continue?**

dsh-computer-history README · Why this exists：The design goal is deliberately different from productivity surveillance. The project records enough local metadata to reconstruct useful work context, while refusing to turn the screen, keyboard or document contents into a history feed.

dsh-computer-history README · At a glance：| | Computer History |
| --- | --- |
| **Storage** | Local SQLite; no remote history service required |
| **Model** | Deterministic observations → Work Episodes → selective resume context |
| **Collection** | Include-only, off by default, fail-closed on protected or uncertain surfaces |
| **Content boundary** | Metadata only — no screenshots, keystrokes, terminal output, source bodies or page bodies |
| **DSH integration** | Authenticated Host API, agent-scoped tools, History / Privacy panel |
| **Companions** | Browser and editor paths for metadata the OS cannot safely provide |

dsh-computer-history README · How it works：

The important property is what is **not** in that pipeline: screen pixels and document contents.

dsh-computer-history README · Privacy boundary：| May be recorded when policy allows it | Designed never to record |
| --- | --- |
| application identity | screenshots or screen recordings |
| resource / workspace metadata | raw keyboard input or mouse coordinates |
| timestamps and duration evidence | clipboard contents |
| element role / identifier metadata | terminal output or shell history |
| privacy / protection state | source-file bodies |
| companion-provided safe resource metadata | browser page bodies |
| | Accessibility text values or selected text |

dsh-computer-history README · Privacy boundary：Capture starts **off**, application access is **include-only**, protected surfaces **fail closed**, and the Host re-screens metadata before storage. The exact guarantees, deletion model and residual risks live in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [docs/threat-model.md](docs/threat-model.md).

dsh-computer-history README · 1. Install in an existing DSH profile：For the **verified DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Host** and an existing Web profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 plugin --profile web add dsh-computer-history@1.0.0
```

Use the profile that your Host actually loads. `web` is an example, **not** a global install. A new profile containing only the DSH base bundle might not serve a Web UI. Do not mix bundle-managed installation with manually inserted legacy `cordis.patch.yml` plugin entries. Reload/restart the Host after the initial installation.

text: dsh-computer-history README · 2. Allow recording deliberately：Open **Computer History**, choose **Start recording**, then open **Settings → Computer History** to allow the specific applications you want to record. Complete any OS accessibility permissions. Recording is **off by default**, the app list is **include-only**, and disallowed apps do not appear in the Timeline. macOS needs Accessibility access, Windows uses UI Automation, and Linux needs a real desktop X/AT-SPI session and permissions.

dsh-computer-history README · 3. Review the Timeline and Continue：Use an allowed app, then return to **Computer History → Timeline**. Select a Work Episode to inspect its evidence. Choose **Continue** to bring bounded, evidence-backed context into a new DSH session — it does **not** reopen apps or files.

Browser and VS Code Companions are **optional** and require their own setup and consent. See [browser setup](docs/companion.md), [editor setup](docs/editor-companion.md), and [privacy policy](SECURITY.md).
